upcoming_trips.field_guide_topic: food and where to eat at Efteling and Beekse Bergen -- food-focused Field Guide, NOT a general trip preview. Per editorial-spec.md § The Field Guide rule 1: subject is FOOD. Both venues are wholly self-contained for this trip -- the reader is staying ONSITE at each, so coverage is restricted to food available within each park / resort estate. No outside-the-gates dining, no nearby-towns coverage, no day-trip food picks. The park / resort estate IS the universe.
upcoming_trips.countdown_topic: trip anticipation -- attractions, accommodation, mood board, moments worth the trip. Per editorial-spec.md § The Countdown: hype over homework, logistics demoted to coda.
upcoming_trips.primary_venue_rationale: Efteling is the primary venue for the Field Guide despite being the shorter stay (2 nights vs 5 at Beekse Bergen). The reader has chosen to weight it as primary because (a) Efteling days are busier and more time-pressured -- knowing where to eat in advance pays off most; (b) theme park food choice is denser and harder to navigate without prep; (c) Beekse Bergen as a safari + resort has more diverse and flexible dining that's discoverable in the moment. Apply rule 7 (multi-venue balance) accordingly: Efteling gets the full Unmissables treatment + ranked meal-slot chapters; Beekse Bergen gets a substantive secondary section (>= 800 words) covering key dining options, standout picks, and practical notes.

access_constraints.notes: Reader is staying ONSITE at both venues for the entire trip (Schiphol -> train -> taxi, then onsite throughout). Field Guide and Countdown coverage is restricted to dining available WITHIN each park / resort estate. Do not include outside-the-gates restaurants, nearby-town picks, day-trip food, or any venue requiring transport off the estate. The estate IS the universe for this reader. Walking distance within the estate is the only relevant access metric for the practical footer; transit modes off the estate are not part of this trip's reality. No car at all on this trip -- the drive-through (self-drive) safari at Beekse Bergen is therefore excluded and must not be elevated as a marquee attraction. The accessible safari modes are the bus safari, the walking safari, and the Kievit boat safari; rank and weight the Safari chapter around those instead.

reader_notes.returning_visitors: Not a first visit. The reader stayed 4 nights at Beekse Bergen last year and visited Efteling for a single day on the same trip. This Countdown is framed as a return, with more time at both venues -- two nights at Efteling (vs. one day previously) and five nights at Beekse Bergen (vs. four). The emotional centre is 'going back, with more time', not 'introducing a place'. Foreword and Mood Board can lean on revisit cues; Top Attractions / Safari chapters can credit the asymmetry (rides and experiences missed last time, evening park atmosphere that requires an overnight, etc.).
reader_notes.no_plan_by_design: The reader has no fixed day-by-day plan beyond meal bookings (which are covered in the Field Guide, not this Countdown). The unstructured shape is intentional and suits the trip. Omit the day-by-day itinerary chapter entirely per the Itinerary rule; do not invent one.
reader_notes.accommodation_surprise: The family is staying in themed suites at the Wonder Hotel at Efteling for both nights, but the specific suite themes are a surprise the reader is keeping from his wife and 10-year-old son. The Accommodation chapter MUST cover the Wonder Hotel in full (rooms, dining, facilities, why it's worth staying inside the gates) and treat the themed-suite range as a CATEGORY (Sprookjessuite, Anton Pieck, Volk van Laaf, Roodkapje, Symbolica, Raveleijn, etc.) without naming or visually indicating which specific suite has been booked. Do not include any photographs that would obviously identify the booked suite. The chapter should read as 'a themed suite at the Wonder' from the family's perspective, with the actual identity preserved as a surprise.

lore_and_legend.framing: Mythology as world-building, the way you would read about a city before visiting. Sprookjesbos, Pardoes, Holle Bolle Gijs, the Fabula universe as a LIVING universe. NOT a history of the park, NOT an Anton Pieck biography -- those are post-trip Deep Dive material. Hype frame: 'a universe you can step into', not 'facts about a theme park'. Carries .hol-anchor as the host block with .hol-fleuron dividers and a .hol-pull--big quote from one of the fairy tales or Fabula lore.

conservation_stories.framing: Real-world counterweight to Efteling's mythology -- Beekse Bergen's serious work on cheetah breeding, white rhino conservation, African painted dogs, EAZA breeding programmes. Read as narrative not corporate -- real animals with names where named individuals exist. NOT a tour of facilities -- stories. Required to satisfy the 60/40 hype-weight rule once Lore & Legend lands on the Efteling side. Carries .hol-anchor with .hol-polaroid imagery of the animals where credited photos exist.

readers_eye_chorus.placement: Threaded as .hol-postcard ephemera between major blocks in EACH HALF (8-15 quotes per half), plus a closing 4-6 quote chorus inside .hol-meanwhile drawing from both venues. NOT a single discrete chapter -- woven through the issue as rhythm breaks per spec rule 'no two consecutive same-pattern blocks'.
readers_eye_chorus.framing: Curated quotes from r/Efteling, r/themeparks, r/Beekse Bergen, TripAdvisor, Google reviews, Dutch YouTube vlog comments, Instagram captions. Every quote attributed by handle/username and source. Third-person chorus -- NEVER framed as 'fellow visitors say' or any reader-instruction phrasing per Gate 1A. Lean into unguarded, specific descriptions -- sensory beats, complaints, vlogger quips. Real voices, lightly edited for length only.
readers_eye_chorus.components: .hol-postcard primary; .hol-pull / .hol-pull--big for the emphasis quotes inside Meanwhile

structural_change_moodboard_position.change: Per-half Mood Board placement is SECOND BLOCK in each half (immediately after the half opener, before Event in Depth / Top Attractions / deeper chapters). structural_change_moodboard_position.rationale: The canonical order front-loads text-heavy pages before any pure-visual breath. Moving Mood Board to position 2 in each half gives the reader the FEEL of the place before the FACTS of it -- hype-over-homework expressed structurally. Rankings-after-atmosphere reads as informed enthusiasm; rankings-before-atmosphere reads as list. Applies per half because of the two-halves architecture.

deep_dive_schedule.rationale: Quarterly-ish cadence with conflict avoidance. The Phase 0 trigger fires a Deep Dive on the next eligible Sunday that satisfies ALL of: (a) at least cadence_weeks[0] weeks since last_fired (or since the schedule was created); (b) no P1 special is due that Sunday (Field Guide / Countdown / Season Review take priority); (c) Sunday is not inside a trip window from upcoming_trips; (d) the backlog is non-empty. If a candidate Sunday fails any check, defer one week. 2026-08-30 is the first clear Sunday after the Efteling/Beekse Bergen trip window (30 Jun - 7 Jul) and the post-trip recovery weeks, giving the format room to breathe in before the autumn news cadence picks up. Manual trigger always available — running /signal with 'deep dive on [topic]' pulls forward and resets the clock.

deep_dive_backlog.scope: From McCulloch-Pitts (1943) and the Dartmouth Summer Research Project (1956) through the symbolic-AI winters, expert systems boom, statistical-learning turn (1990s), the deep-learning revolution (2012, AlexNet), the transformer era (2017 onward), and the consumer-facing inflection (ChatGPT 2022 forward). Treat as intellectual history: ideas, key labs, key figures, why each wave broke. Mark contested interpretive frames (scaling-is-all-you-need vs structure-matters; safety/doom debate). Visual taxonomy must include: timeline of seminal papers/launches, chart of compute-per-model over time, diagram of transformer architecture, photography of key figures and lab spaces.
deep_dive_backlog.expanded_scope_rationale: 80 years of intellectual history with multiple ideologies and inflection points. Each era (symbolic / statistical / deep / transformer) deserves a full chapter of ~2000 words. Estimated 15-18k words.

deep_dive_backlog.topic: The rise and fall of Napoleon
deep_dive_backlog.scope: Toulon to St Helena, 1793-1821. Treat as biographical narrative not academic treatise. Weight Russia and Waterloo as turning points. Cover military campaigns, political consolidation, and the imperial project. Include primary-source quotes where credited (Napoleon's letters, contemporary observers — Bourrienne, Mme de Remusat, Wellington). Visual taxonomy must include: timeline of campaigns, map of the 1812 Russia campaign (and Europe-in-1812 territory map), chart of Grande Armee strength across campaigns, painting selection (David, Goya, Gericault) with annotated detail, primary-source quote panels. Skip the reading-paths navigator if it doesn't suit a continuous biographical arc.
deep_dive_backlog.expanded_scope_rationale: Twenty-eight years of continuous military and political activity across multiple distinct eras (revolutionary general, First Consul, Emperor, exile, return, exile). 12k words leaves each chapter ~1200 words and Russia in particular needs more. Estimated 15-17k.

deep_dive_backlog.scope: REQUIRES SHARPENING before commissioning. 'A history of Europe' is too wide for even an expanded Deep Dive. Possible angles to choose from at trigger time: (a) the long peace and its end (1815-1914, Congress of Vienna to outbreak of WWI); (b) the making of Europe (Carolingian to Westphalian, 800-1648); (c) Europe in the long twentieth century (1914-1991, two wars and a cold one); (d) the European project (1945-present, ECSC / EEC / EU / Brexit, the integration story). Pick one when commissioning. The other three become future backlog entries.

George Lucas's New Hope through the Disney era. Cover: Lucas's USC years and the THX-1138 / American Graffiti precursors; the desperate production of A New Hope and the unexpected success; Empire and Jedi; the Special Editions; the prequels and their critical-vs-commercial split; the EU / Legends purge; the Disney acquisition and the sequel trilogy; Andor / Mandalorian / the streaming era. Treat as production history and cultural history together. Visual taxonomy must include: timeline of releases (films, TV, key behind-the-scenes events); behind-the-scenes photography (concept art, set photos, miniatures); annotated stills; chart of box office adjusted for inflation; comparison table of trilogies on critical / commercial reception; primary-source quotes from Lucas, Kennedy, Johnson, Filoni. NOTE: Star Wars is locked-register for The Signal (no spoiler-leaking from current ongoing shows beyond what the spec already permits).
deep_dive_backlog.expanded_scope_rationale: Fits comfortably in the 8-12k band. ~50 years, ~12 chapters, ~1k words each.

deep_dive_backlog.scope: From hanafuda card production in Kyoto (1889) through pachinko, taxi services, love hotels (the often-forgotten experimental decades), into video games via the Magnavox Odyssey deal, the Game & Watch / Donkey Kong / Famicom rise, the Yamauchi-Iwata succession, the GameCube wilderness, the Wii / DS pivot to casual audiences, the Wii U failure, the Switch resurrection, and Switch 2. Treat as business and cultural history together. Centre Iwata's leadership and design philosophy (lateral-thinking-with-withered-technology). Visual taxonomy must include: timeline of consoles and key games, photography of consoles and Kyoto HQ, comparison table of console-generation unit sales, chart of Nintendo financials across the decades, primary-source quotes from Yamauchi / Iwata / Miyamoto / Furukawa.

The evidence-based revolution. Trace strength training science from early Russian and East German sports science through the muscle confusion / bro-science era, into the modern hypertrophy literature (Schoenfeld, Helms, Israetel, the MRV/MEV/MAV framework, volume-vs-intensity debates, frequency optimisation, proximity to failure, mind-muscle connection). End with where the consensus actually is in 2026 and where it isn't. Treat as scientific intellectual history with practical relevance. Apply interpretive-diversity rule: surface ongoing disagreements (e.g., Mike Israetel's high-volume position vs Greg Nuckols' moderate-volume reading of the same data). Visual taxonomy must include: timeline of seminal studies, diagrams of muscle hypertrophy mechanisms (mechanical tension / metabolic stress / muscle damage models), charts of dose-response curves from real meta-analyses, comparison table of MRV/MEV/MAV thresholds across major muscle groups, primary-source quotes from researchers. NOTE: Apply Gate 1A — write for any reader, not for the reader's specific Ibex programme. Programmes can be named as character (e.g. 'the Lyss Method emphasises X'); never addressed at the reader.
deep_dive_backlog.expanded_scope_rationale: Fits comfortably in 8-12k. Tight subject with clear scope.
